name: Z01
summary: Z01 is a bipedal humanoid developed within Zoomlion’s Zhongke Yungu robotics business. The company demonstrated wire-handling and sorting skills learned through imitation, alongside visitor interaction, greeting and guided tours. The robot is part of a wider portfolio sharing the group’s embodied intelligence software and industrial development environments. Public demonstrations establish the product, while general commercial availability has not been verified.
